name: pwninit
description: Automates CTF pwn challenge setup: fetches the matching loader and libraries, unstrips libc, and patches binaries. Provides MCP tools plus a human CLI.

interface.shortDescription: CTF pwn challenge setup via MCP
interface.longDescription: Automates CTF pwn challenge setup: downloads the matching dynamic loader and required libraries for a challenge's libc, unstrips libc for source-level GDB debugging, patches binaries to run against the target libc, and fetches glibc source files. Exposes MCP tools for Codex agents while keeping a full CLI for humans.
defaultPrompt: Set up this pwn challenge with pwninit
Fetch malloc.c source for this challenge's libc
Patch this binary to run with the given libc
